notes.item_49: Rates per RM250 or part: RM1 (<=1yr), RM3 (>1-3yr), RM5 (>3-5yr), RM7 (>5yr or indefinite). The STSDS blueprint (STSDS-SDLC-2026-V1) states RM1/RM2/RM4; two secondary sources agree on RM1/RM3/RM5/RM7. Head of Tax must confirm against the gazetted First Schedule before sign-off.
notes.item_49_boundary: Exactly 36 months is treated as 'not exceeding 3 years' (RM3) and exactly 60 months as 'not exceeding 5 years' (RM5). Confirm with Head of Tax.
notes.item_32: Tier duty is RM per RM100 or part thereof, applied per tier (not a raw percentage). The blueprint's percentage formula under-assesses amounts that are not multiples of RM100.
notes.item_32_foreign: Non-citizen residential: RM8 per RM100 from 2026-01-01. Non-citizen non-residential: RM4 per RM100. Confirm with Head of Tax.
notes.item_22: Only secured loans at 0.5% (RM5 per RM1,000 or part) are computed automatically. Other loan or security types are routed to review.
notes.item_4: Wage exemption of RM3,000/month reported by PwC Malaysia Tax Booklet; KPMG (Dec 2025) described it as a Finance Bill proposal. Confirm enactment before sign-off.
notes.duplicate_copy_duty: RM10 per duplicate copy is stated only in the blueprint and is unverified.
notes.min_duty: RM10 minimum duty under Section 36CB (corroborated by two secondary sources).
